Music is subjective to people's opinions. I for example loved this album more than every other, every other album of enhypen's had at least 1 or 2 songs where I listened to during promotions to support them then stopped because they weren't catchy enough to keep me engaged. This album though, i have listened to it twice in an hour and I didn't even realise I was done because of how much fun the songs are. Everyone has different tastes.
​@mrs_choco_6384Yeah, its absolutely fine. Everyone has different taste. For me, its my least favourite album of enha. Dark moon and sin: vanish are my top favourites.

It's the same thing I thought while listening to the album. Personally I liked it except for two songs, but I was thinking 'what are they trying to say? What direction is the album supposed to go?' because only the first three songs have romantic lyrics in my opinion, the rest of the album doesn't and as a whole it feels like a salad of albums. Musically it's not the best either. Objectively looking at it as a musical production, it's better than _Sin Desire_ but it's not even close to being the best album in their discography. That title belongs to _Dark Moon_ and so far nothing but XO's album even comes close to competing with it. It's sad but well, it's something that happens to all HYBE groups in general
